name: quick resource pack
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: emqnuele
description: Toggle resource packs and texture packs with a hotkey, no loading screen. Pack wheel, key slots, profiles, and auto-switching per server, world or dimension.
works: R toggles one chosen resource pack on and off and says '<pack> enabled/disabled' in chat; with no pack chosen it says 'No resource pack configured'. The pack is chosen in its own menu or Cloth Config screen.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: choosing the pack needs its own menu or settings screen, which don't open (its menu key has no default), so the try only checks R's answer with no pack chosen; the mod works without it
